// about

Systems thinking, applied to your busywork.

I'm Juliet, a Business Workflow Automation Specialist focused on one thing: taking the manual, repetitive work that quietly eats a founder's week and rebuilding it as a workflow that just runs.

I work across Monday.com, Make.com, Zapier, Airtable, and Go High Level to design systems — not just single automations — that connect your intake forms, your team boards, your emails, and your reporting into one clean pipeline.

I've built these systems for organizations ranging from short-term rental operators to an airline training institution, and every build starts with the same question: where is your time actually going, and how do we get it back?

Who I work best with

  • Founders drowning in manual, repetitive admin
  • Teams juggling forms, spreadsheets, and email with no single system
  • Businesses ready to move onto Monday.com or Airtable properly
  • Anyone who wants their tools talking to each other automatically
// services

What I can take off your plate

Every engagement starts with mapping the manual work, then building the system that replaces it.

01

Workflow Audit & Strategy

I map your current process end-to-end, flag every manual bottleneck, and hand you a clear plan for what to automate first.

02

Automation Build (Make.com / Zapier / n8n)

Multi-step, multi-app automations — forms to databases to notifications to emails — built, tested, and documented.

03

Monday.com Systems Setup

Boards, automations, permissions, and dashboards designed around how your team actually works, not a generic template.

04

Airtable Systems & Interfaces

Structured databases and client-friendly interfaces for tracking, intake, and reporting — built to scale with you.

05

Go High Level Setup

Pipelines, follow-ups, and client communication set up so leads and clients are never waiting on a manual reply.

06

Ongoing Support & Optimization

Systems drift as your business grows. I keep yours tuned, fix what breaks, and extend it as new needs come up.

07

CRM Migration & Full Build-Out

CRM migration or complete build-out for your company across platforms like Monday.com, HubSpot, Airtable, or any other platform of your choice.

// client work

Systems I've built for clients

Jara — Workload Visibility & Due Date Alerts

Monday.comSlackGmailAutomation Agent

For a jewellery distribution and production company, management had no visibility into who on the team was overworked versus free, and client or production due dates could pass without warning. I connected Slack and Gmail to their Monday.com operations base and set up an automation agent that notifies management at 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, and 1 day before each due date — for both client and production deadlines — so nothing slips through and work can be distributed evenly.

Flymates — Student Registration & Course Tracking

ZapierGoogle SheetsMonday.comCanva

Built a registration and course-tracking system for an airline training institution, covering roughly 1,000 students — including bulk certificate generation.

Koka Shortlet — Full Operations System

Monday.com

A fully integrated operations system spanning Maintenance, Guest Experience, and Procurement & Inventory — board structures, automations, permissions, dashboards, and a structured 25-issue data table.

Grant Program Automation

Make.comTallyAirtableGmailMonday.com
